The mapped status key or the default numeric identifier (1-5) of the status that the lead should be updated to. To use keys, they must first be mapped by a Get The Referral Integration Engineer.
**Sold** referrals can not be updated to **Closed** or **Working**. **Closed** referrals cannot be updated to **Working**.

---------|----------
 Unverified | 1
 Working | 5
 Verified | 2
 Sold | 3
 Closed/Lost | 4
 Ineligible | 6
